description: Next Generation Liquefaction (NGL) - Supporting Studies: Overburden and Initial Shear Stress is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Brian Carlton, Norwegian Geotechnical Institute (ngi.no). Results from laboratory tests have shown that effective confining pressure and non-zero initial static shear stress can affect a soil’s cyclic resistance ratio (CRR). To account for these effects, the factors Kσ and Kα are used to modify the CRR, respectively. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-c9fr-x257. Keywords: soil liquefaction; cyclic laboratory tests; earthquake engineering; overburden stress; static shear stress;. Published 2023-05-09. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
